LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureBaitReadyUnmet: Honey scent: wafting ({0} conditions not met, see the Conditions tab)
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureNoBait: Honey scent: none (place honey, ambrosia or berries on it)
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureAwaitingSettlers: A band of vivis is expected in about {0}.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureConditionMap: Vivis do not come to this map.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureConditionRoyal: A royal vivi is already on this map.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureConditionTemperature: It is too hot or too cold outside for vivis.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureConditionWeather: It is dangerous to be outside now.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureConditionUnreachable: The vivis cannot reach the structure from the map edge.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureMissingRoom: No empty structure nearby with a door and a full roof.
LanguageData.VV_Inspector_LureMissingGrowingPeriod: The flowers here grow for too short a season to gather enough honey for the winter.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_Idle: Waiting for visitors. When all visit conditions are met, visitors following the honey scent come now and then; if the nest site conditions are met too, a band of vivis may follow the scouts and move in.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_NoRoyal: No royal vivi on the map
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_TemperatureTip: It must be a temperature vivis in basic clothes can endure outdoors. Both the current and the seasonal temperature count.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_WeatherTip: Vivis do not come during toxic fallout, noxious haze or other conditions that make it dangerous to be outside.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_BaitTip: Place honey, ambrosia, honey dishes or berries on the lure to spread the scent. Visiting scouts eat one each while sniffing; bears eat it all.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_NoOtherLure: No other lure in progress and no nest
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_FlowersTip: Honey flowers near the lure. The more flowers, the higher the flower score.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_Room: Empty roofed structure with a door
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_RoomTip: The best structure near the lure. Rooms joined by doors count as one structure. It needs a door and a full roof; structures that are too small or too large, joined to someone's bedroom or a prison, or on a gravship are not used. A well-sized structure with few buildings inside (except arcane plants, pots and lures) scores higher.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_RoomReachable: Path from the map edge to the structure
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_FertileSoilTip: Fertile land near the lure with no roof, building or zone. A vivi nest plants cotton, roses and arcane plants there and digs mana fertilizer out of the soil.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_GrowingPeriod: Growing period of at least {0} days
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_GrowingPeriodTip: Same as the growing period on the world map's terrain tab. A vivi nest gathers honey while the flowers grow and lives on it through the winter, so the vivis will not settle where the growing period is short.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_ManaTip: Environment mana near the lure. Not required; the higher it is, the higher the mana score.
LanguageData.VV_ITab_ViviLure_ScoreTip: The flower, structure and mana scores combined (flowers count the most, mana the least). The higher it is, the sooner and the more vivis come.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviLureScouts: {1} vivi(s) of {0} followed the honey scent of your lure.\n\nThey will look around the lure, the flowers and the rooms nearby. If they like what they see, a small band may come back to live here.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviLureHornet: A titanic hornet has caught the honey scent of your lure and is coming for it. Hornets are in a frenzy and attack anything nearby.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviLureBear: {PAWN_definite} has caught the honey scent and is coming for the lure.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviLureScoutsFled: The vivi scouts left in a hurry. They will not report this place.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviLureScoutsDisappointed: The vivi scouts left without much interest.\n{0}
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviLureScoutsSatisfied: The vivi scouts liked this place. A band of vivis may come soon.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviNestSettlers:
A band of {1} vivis from {0} has come to live in the empty room near your lure.

They gather honey, pollen and propolis from the flowers and trees around, make cream and wax, and build what they need on their own. Their stores are marked forbidden; you may take them freely.

The vivis do not mind your colonists nearby, but they grow wary quickly when your people step inside their rooms. If they become too wary, they will turn hostile and leave. Keep your people out by forbidding the doors of their rooms or by setting allowed areas.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestSettlersCanceled: The vivi band that was expected did not come.\n{0}
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestWary: The vivis of {0} are getting wary of your colonists in their rooms.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestVeryWary: The vivis of {0} are very wary. Keep your colonists out of their rooms.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestRescuedReturned: {PAWN_definite} has gone back to the nest, grateful for the rescue.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestLeavingFew: The vivis of {0} are leaving: too few of them are left.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestLeavingStarving: The vivis of {0} are leaving: they have been starving for too long.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ViviNestLeavingRoomLost: The vivis of {0} are leaving: their nest room is gone.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviNestAlmostHostile: The vivis of {0} are about to lose their patience. If your colonists keep entering their rooms or harm them, they will turn hostile and leave.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviNestHostile: The vivis of {0} have turned hostile and are fleeing their nest.
